# Bracers of Defense (`magic-items:bracers-of-defense`)
**Category:** [Wondrous Items](../equipment-categories/wondrous-items.md) | **Rarity:** Rare | **Attunement:** Yes

Wondrous Item

While wearing these bracers, you gain a +2 bonus to Armor Class if you are wearing no armor and using no Shield.
